purpose: 静态美术样板；未接入 App，不表示主题或三维转场已实现。

reference.status: 用户已确认；复用上一阶段透明素材

variants.label: 开心
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED CALM MOOD PLANET and the strict visual-family reference. Create ONE additional mood state of this SAME miniature liuli glass planet. Keep square canvas, front view, full circular silhouette, complete object in frame with padding, transparent background, approximately the same scale and composition, thick overlapping translucent colored glass hills, three small stylized pine trees and milky glass clouds. Preserve the approved balance of softly illustrated shapes and precious handcrafted glass, selective gold-leaf flecks, a few bubbles and painted rim light. Do not revert to flat clipart, change into a plastic toy, or create a different world. Mood differences must be visible in large internal shapes and river/cloud arrangement as well as color.
The winding luminous river is always the primary visual focus, continuously readable from the far hills into the foreground. Keep clouds from obscuring its main path. All moods remain cared for, luminous and beautiful; no mood is graded good or bad.
Lighting consistent: soft upper-left source, gentle inner light and selectively illuminated glass edges. Bright clear midtones, transparent depth and cream highlights. Sparse tiny bubbles and gold flecks in only a few glass areas, calm broad surfaces elsewhere. Entire object sharp. Real transparent alpha background, no floor, room, backdrop, stars outside the globe, outer orbital rings, UI, text, watermark, faces, extra characters or other planets.
Do not add destruction, dead trees, cracks, storms, lightning, faces, fire, volcanic lava, spikes, threatening imagery, noisy glitter, chrome or neon. Three trees remain healthy and intact. Keep the SAME illustration/material language as the approved reference.
MOOD: HAPPY — open, expansive and buoyant. Glass palette of clear honey-gold, warm apricot and fresh yellow-green jade, with milky peach edges. Broad hill curves open outward and leave an airy luminous space in the center. The S-shaped river has generous, soft flowing bends and bright champagne-gold light, with two fine light threads. Side clouds are smaller, separated and placed a little higher near the sides, revealing more of the glass world. Small round suspended bubbles inside the upper glass suggest lightness. The composition has upward ease while still being one grounded spherical world. Use rounded relaxed shapes and a warm clear glow, no cartoon sun character or celebratory confetti. The open center, broad river and lifted clouds should distinguish this from the calm reference at small mobile size.

Broad hills softly curve inward around a visible bowl-like hollow; the winding river gathers into a clearly shaped small teardrop-like LIGHT POOL in the foreground, contained inside the planet.
